prompt:
Break this request into issues we can ship one at a time, and save the breakdown as slices.json in the repo root so we can lint it before creating issues.

Request: users can reset a forgotten password. They ask for a reset link by email, the link expires after one hour, they pick a new password that meets our existing password rules, and every other signed-in session is logged out afterwards. Auth code is in src/auth/, pages are in web/pages/.
rubric: Each slice ends in behavior a user can observe (not a layer like 'database' or 'API'), the first slice is a thin end-to-end path, and every slice criterion names a test or command as proof.
